title: Book a Discovery Call | Vertical Wealth
description: Book a free 15-minute discovery call with Brian Wheeler. No pressure and no statements needed, just a big-picture talk about your goals and questions.

blocks.headline: Book a discovery call
blocks.body: Fifteen minutes with Brian, with no pressure and no statements needed. It's a big-picture conversation about your story, your goals and your biggest questions, and a chance to see if we're the right fit.
blocks.imageAlt: Brian Wheeler, founder of Vertical Wealth

blocks.heading: Choose a time
blocks.body: Set your time zone in the calendar, then pick a day and time that works for you.

blocks.heading: What happens next
items: Discovery call: About 15 minutes with Brian. Share your story, your goals and your biggest questions.
Deep dive: If it's a fit, we schedule a 1 to 2 hour meeting to gather the details, learn about your values, hopes and dreams, and analyze your full picture.
Your plan: We present a clear, customized plan and help you put it into action.

blocks.heading: Prefer to call or email?
blocks.body:
If the calendar doesn't load or no time works for you, reach us directly.

**Phone:** [(317) 794-2148](tel:+13177942148)

**Email:** [info@verticalwealth.life](mailto:info@verticalwealth.life)

Our office is at the Atrium, 10330 N Meridian St, Ste 300, Indianapolis, IN 46290.

items.question: Is the discovery call free?
items.answer: Yes. The discovery call is complimentary and comes with no obligation.

items.question: What should I bring?
items.answer: Just your questions. There's no need to bring statements. It's a big-picture conversation about your story and your goals.

items.question: Who will I talk to?
items.answer: Brian Wheeler, our founder and Chief Vision Officer. Brian has been in the financial business since 2000. [Meet the team](/team).

items.question: What happens after the call?
items.answer: If it looks like a good fit, we schedule the deep dive, a 1 to 2 hour meeting where we gather your financial information and talk about your values, hopes and dreams. If it isn't a fit, there's no pressure. [See how it works](/how-it-works).

items.question: How do your fees work?
items.answer: We're fiduciary and fee-based. Advisory fees are a percentage of the assets we manage. The full fee schedule is in our Form ADV, available on request. The discovery call itself is free.

blocks.heading: Not ready to talk yet?
blocks.body: Get Weekly Lessons, one short email each week with scripture, a thought from Brian and one idea you can use. It's free, and you can unsubscribe any time.
